summary_en: The caller initiated the call to inquire about the consultation fee and business operating hours. The agent provided the details, stating that the consultation fee is ₹300 and the business is open from Monday to Saturday, between 10:00 AM and 8:00 PM. The caller, identifying himself as Kiran, requested that his inquiry be noted and expressed interest in the services. The agent confirmed that the inquiry was logged. The caller indicated that he had no further questions and thanked the agent, after which the call was concluded.
